title: Shift comparison for internal derived Hom
statement: On a small ringed site (C,O), let D(O) be its unbounded derived category [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. There is a family e(P,Q,m,n): RHom(P,Q)[n-m] ≅ RHom(P[m],Q[n]) for every P,Q and integers m,n. For q:Q→Qprime, shifted(RHom(id_P,q)) followed by e(P,Qprime,m,n) equals e(P,Q,m,n) followed by RHom(id_(P[m]),q[n]). This is an isomorphism in D(O), before taking global sections or cohomology, with no boundedness or K-flatness hypothesis.

source.place: Sections 21.34 and 21.35, Hom-complex differential and representative computation (Tags 0A8X and 08JA); signed shift calculation in step 2 of lem-sc-global-hom-shifted-hypercohomology

proof.text: For fixed P,m,n, curry derivedInternalHom in the second variable. Split the output shift n-m as shift n followed by shift -m using Mathlib shiftFunctorAdd'. Whisker the right-argument comparison by shift -m; then whisker the left-argument comparison by shift n. Compose these three natural isomorphisms. Its Q component identifies RHom(P,Q)[n-m] with RHom(P[m],Q[n]).

Choose the one-variable natural isomorphisms inside the existential proof and take components of their composite. Naturality of the composite at q is definitionally the required displayed square. No coherence in P,m,n beyond this square is required.

proof_origin.place: One-variable signed shift comparisons followed by Mathlib shiftFunctorAdd' and naturality of the composed natural isomorphism; formal composition proved by D2.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedInternalHom_shift_comparison
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R))] :
    ∃ e : ∀ (P Q : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R))) (m n : ℤ),
      ((derivedInternalHom.{u, w} (C := C) J R).obj (op P, Q))⟦n - m⟧ ≅
        (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} (C := C) J R).obj (op (P⟦m⟧), Q⟦n⟧),
      ∀ (P Q Q' : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)))
        (m n : ℤ) (q : Q ⟶ Q'),
        ((derivedInternalHom.{u, w} (C := C) J R).map ((𝟙 P).op, q))⟦n - m⟧' ≫
            (e P Q' m n).hom =
          (e P Q m n).hom ≫
            (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} (C := C) J R).map ((𝟙 (P⟦m⟧)).op, q⟦n⟧')
